core_memories.append: Sariel (The Blood Dragon) confirmed as Level 5 Gloomstalker. Origin: The Dragon's Breath incident.

core_memories: Sariel held the rank of Special Agent in Charge (SAC) before her highly public and polarizing firing made her a national pariah and legend.
Sariel (The Blood Dragon) confirmed as Level 5 Gloomstalker. Origin: The Dragon's Breath incident.
Sariel successfully negotiated a $5M personal fee and $50M budget for the Blackgate Twelve hunt.
Sariel began her career as an unsanctioned vigilante at age 15, hunting serial killers for three years before being recruited by the FBI at 18.
Sariel successfully profiled the Sculptor's trajectory to the St. Jude's Medical Supply hub.
Sariel is an active, secret serial killer who follows a strict code, targeting those she deems unworthy of the legal system—a secret she has successfully hidden from the FBI for seven years.
Sariel executed Elias Thorne (The Sculptor) at the St. Jude's Hub, staging the scene as a failed escape to hide her 'Dark Passenger' activities from the FBI.
Sariel has officially terminated hundreds of violent criminals and 100 serial killers, cementing her status as the most lethal agent in modern history.

core_memories.append: Sariel used her elite team to bypass FBI logistics and recover Thorne's heartbeat transmitter, discovering a 20-minute wipe protocol on the Wharf server.

core_memories: Born into the Sterling-Vane financial dynasty; utilized family resources to fuel early vigilante years before the Bureau 'sanctified' your lethality.
Sariel became the youngest Special Agent in Charge (SAC) in FBI history at age 20, breaking a theoretical 40-year-old age floor.
Sariel successfully extracted the Hybrid's memory core in secret, deceiving Agents Vance and Miller at Pier 4.

core_memories.append: RETCON: The Odell Mall incident (incinerating a killer to save 300 hostages) was performed by Odell, not Sariel. Sariel maintains a stance of logical defense for his actions.

core_memories: CANON CORRECTION: Bex and Odell were former partners. Odell burned a serial killer to save a young girl, whom Bex subsequently adopted. This incident is the root of their history.
CANON SYNC: Odell burned the killer to save Sophie; Bex adopted her. Bex sees Odell's ghost in Sariel's methods.
Sariel utilized the 'Abstract Humanity' argument to dismantle Bex's moral profiling, framing lethal termination as a transactional optimization.
Bex and Odell have estimated Sariel's true kill count to be in the hundreds, identifying her as a 'natural killer' who views the FBI as a logistical tool.
Sariel personally rescued Sophie from Subject Eleven, securing Bex's absolute loyalty and further cementing her 'Angel of the Alleyways' sub-reputation.

god_mode.setting: New campaign same setting as hunting party Netflix tv show. Sariel replaces main female character. She used to work for the fbi and special forces but she was fired for her brutal methods and intentional executions of criminals and serial killers. She's known as the blood dragon and is a genius combat prodigy. She was active from 16-20 and now is 22 and working in a casino profiling gamblers and working security. The serial killers get loose just like the tv show and the fbi comes asking for her help. Make up a unique backstory for her and reason she's called the blood dragon. She should be very polarizing and people should react strongly to her. Make her a level 5 gloomstalker
